channel.description: How much concrete, gravel, mulch, topsoil, or paint to buy, worked out before you go to the store.

item.title: How Many Bags of Concrete for a 10x10 Slab? (Free Calculator)
item.description: A 10 x 10 ft patio slab 4 inches thick takes 33.33 cubic feet (1.23 cubic yards) of concrete: 62 bags of 80 lb mix or 82 bags of 60 lb mix with 10% extra for waste. Enter your own slab, round pad, or post holes to get cubic yards and bag counts. Free, no sign-up.
